storyline.situation: A hurricane forecast tells you where the storm goes, not what it costs a given county in outages, shelter demand, or staging needs.
storyline.problem: Large operators run 24/7 ops centers linking forecast to logistics; most counties and community organizations don't. Staging decisions are made under uncertainty with no tested, open tool.
storyline.recommendation: A pipeline that mirrors the sponsor's own Detection-to-Human-Decision flow: NHC-forecast-error scenarios, an XGBoost impact model backtested on 10 years of EAGLE-I outage data, a published stochastic-programming staging optimizer, and an AI agent whose every output is checked by a trust layer before a human sees it.

storyline_approval_note: User request specified exact slide topics, section references, and phrasing requirements in the task brief itself, constituting approval in a single-pass subagent invocation.
audit_notes: 11 heuristic auditor flags reviewed and cleared: 7 are 2-line header_title wraps against the nominal 0.75in box height (font_headline_size 26 on long assertion headlines) -- verified by geometry that all end ~1.0-1.05in, before CONTENT_TOP (1.3in) or the diagram oval_y (2.2-2.5in), so no actual collision with slide content. 3 are 'bullets on slide' counts on three-col/two-col slides (2, 4, 8, 12) where the flat per-slide sum exceeds 4 but each column/block individually carries <=3-4 short items, matching the layout_three_col/layout_two_col primitives' intended use for parallel short lists. 1 is a verb-detection heuristic miss on slide 12 ('Four workstreams run in parallel toward an Oct 5 build freeze' -- has a verb, 'run').
